name: Siam Kempinski Hotel Bangkok
positioning: Urban Kempinski hotel in Bangkok with landscaped gardens, saltwater pools and a suite experience that includes shopping privileges at nearby Siam malls
best_for: Families who want a kids club and gardens with pools in the city
Guests in suites who want a private chef breakfast and a personal concierge host

facts.text: The Exquisite Suite Experience covers five suites: Royal Suite, Presidential Terrace Suite, Penthouse Suite, Presidential Suite and Terrace Suite.
The Exquisite Suite Experience includes Bvlgari bath amenities.
The Exquisite Suite Experience includes fast-track service at Suvarnabhumi Airport.
The Executive Lounge is on floor 17 of the high-rise Royal Wing I building.
The Kempinski Kids Club is on the ground floor of the Royal Wing and welcomes children up to 12 years.
Children up to five years eat the breakfast buffet at no charge.
The hotel's limousine fleet includes BMW series 7 cars and a Mercedes-Benz V-Class Van.
The concierge can book restaurant tables, theatre or concert tickets, or plan a bespoke adventure.

highlights.text: The hotel has extensive landscaped gardens with multiple saltwater swimming pools, including one for children.
A host called the Lady in Red, dressed in red, helps guests with questions about the hotel and the local area.
The Exquisite Suite Experience includes shopping privileges at Siam Paragon, Siam Center, Siam Discovery and ICONSIAM.
The Kempinski Health Club has Technogym equipment and Muay Thai classes.
The Exquisite Suite Experience includes a private chef service for daily in-suite breakfast.

considerations.text: Pets are not permitted in restaurants, public areas or the hotel gardens.
